verdict.rationale: Asana's own site lists AI Studio as "Powerful no-code automations", and its developer docs mention native rules with rule actions, so first-party no-code automation exists. The evidence does not show that these automations chain multiple steps, and gives no detail on the builder or hands-on corroboration. Third-party tools like Zapier, n8n and Pipedream are partner integrations, not Asana's own capability, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-step chained workflows, documentation of the rule/AI Studio builder (triggers, conditions, actions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
